items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Not Walter Thomas? ... Walter was a good full of it, too. He died, you know. [INTERVIEWEE] Walter Thomas died? Yeah.

ctx.x: Not Walter Thomas? No, no, not Walter. Walter was a good full of it, too. He died, you know.

Walter Thomas died? Yeah. And, uh, well, that boat trip, that boat trip, that boat trip, I was a little bit of help to a lot of musicians, see. The guys should give Manuel a lot of credit, because he was down there and he knows the guys, because I was laughing for him, Albert Schneider, all those guys, and Willie Umpfer and all those guys, see. Because when I left, I didn't know Willie was playing that much Planet Man that they recommended. I knowed of them, but didn't know what they could do, see. Until Willie…
Oh, there was a lot of people.
